newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products close higher on soybean gains.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products close higher on soybean gains.

text.p: CBOT soy product futures closed higher on gains in soybeans tied to concerns about some outlooks for a frost early next week in the northern portion of the U.S. soybean growing region, traders said.

Several meteorologists early Friday said cold weather would move into the northern Midwest Tuesday and Wednesday and at least one forecaster said even colder temperatures were expected late next week.
Soyoil closed 0.20 to 0.39 cent per lb higher with October up 0.19 at 25.25. Soymeal was $0.30 to $2.50 per ton higher, with October up $0.30 at $259.00.
Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 13,000, down from 17,872 Thursday, according to the CBOT. Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 20,000, down from 30,827 Thursday.
